CABRERA General Manager LAGUNA LAKE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY Km. 24 Marina East Road Don Hilario Cruz Avenue Club Manila East Compound, Brgy San Juan DILG Opinion No. 12 s. 2011 AND LOCAL CENTRAL RECORDS RELEASED SIGNATURE NO. Taytay, Rizal Subject: QUERY ON THE USE BY A LOCAL GOVERNMENT FROM ITS OWN SLAUGHTERHOUSE TO PARTLY WATERWASTE TREATMENT FACILITY UNIT OF THE REVENUE OR WHOLLY FINANCE A Dear Mr. Cabrera: This has reference to your inquiry on whether the revenues of Local Government Units (LGUs) from the operation of their own slaughterhouses can be used establishment of Wastewater Treatment Facilities. It is our view that the same may be undertaken by an LGU, vested in it by RA 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991. Some pertinent provisions of the Code support this view: to partly or wholly finance the considering the economic powers I. 2. 3. 4. The establishment and operation of slaughterhouses is one of the basic services facilities that LGUS can provide (Section 17(b)(2)(ix) and (4), RA 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991) and the local sanggunian (city and municipality) have the power to approve ordinances establishing these slaughterhouses (Section 446(5)(ii) and 457 (5)(ii), RA 7160) The basic services and facilities enumerated under RA 7160 shall be funded from the share of the LGUs in the proceeds of national taxes and local revenues and funding support from the the National Government, its instrumentalities and government-owned or controlled corporations. (Section 17(g), RA 7160) LGUs have the power and authority to create their own sources of revenue which shall accrue to exclusively for their use and disposition and which shall be retained by them. (Sections 18 and 129, RA 7160) LGUs shall enjoy full autonomy in the exercise of their proprietary functions and in the management of their economic enterprises. (Sections 22(d), RA 7160) In sum, the establishment and/or operation of a slaughterhouse by an LGU is a valid exercise of its proprietary and economic powers, and the discretion to use the revenues from the operation thereof rests in the sound discretion of the LGU, provided that the authority to do so is sanctioned by a valid resolution from the local sanggunian, and that sufficient funds remain to sustain the operations of the slaughterhouse, including the payment of salaries and wages of the slaughterhouse personnel. We hope to have sufficiently addressed your concern. Very truly yours, ATTY. JES B. Director III cc. Asec. Rolando M. Acosta DILG LS:55 QUE IV
